name: phase-6.7-evidence-gauntlet
purpose: Three diff-scoped mechanical checks (mutation, changed-lines coverage, test-order independence) wired into /commit as a host-issued Arcane check.

arcane_mapping.normalize_reference: Arcane normalizeCheck: reads executor and status from caller data only when authority !== 'model'

layers.name: mutation
layers.what: Inject a fault per added line; rerun the test command; report survived vs killed.

layers.name: coverage
layers.what: NODE_V8_COVERAGE driven test run; report fraction of added lines executed.
layers.ok_when: all added lines executed at least once

layers.name: order
layers.what: Seed Fisher-Yates shuffle over test files; rerun N times; every run must pass.

anti_gaming: Never weaken a test to make the gauntlet pass.
Never report an unrun check as passed.
Mutators that don't match the line's syntactic shape are reported as skipped, never silently ignored.
Coverage filters to the diff's added lines only; whole-repo coverage is discarded.

evidence_shape.specification: phase-6.7 evidence gauntlet: mutation + changed-lines coverage + test-order independence
